observations.text: The canvas is a React Flow node graph (data-testid rf__wrapper / rf__node-*). Node type prefixes seen: i (image), v (video, also used by 智能剪辑), n (导演台), g (group), a (audio).
Unit of work: 工作区/项目 (spaceId + projectId in URL) → contains one or more 画布 (canvas switcher with 新建画布) → contains nodes. Project title is an inline editable input (未命名工作区 / 未命名项目).
Persistence: header shows 同步中 → 已同步 after every mutation; nodes created from the empty-state template survived a full page reload (2 nodes after reload).
Clicking 新建项目 in the LibTV sidebar creates a new project immediately (no dialog) and lands in /canvas with spaceId+projectId and the Agent drawer open in 新对话 state.

Home tool cards (Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0, Minimax H3 Max, 导演台, 逐帧拉片, 片段重拍) open /canvas?sourceSpaceId=…&sourceProjectUuid=… which clones a template project into a NEW project in the user's workspace (URL rewrites to fresh spaceId/projectId; node titles carry the suffix '- 副本').

Professional tools are therefore NOT separate pages: 导演台 is a node type (n) with an inline '打开导演台' button ('在3D空间中搭建场景并进行多视角截图') and a downstream '导演台 2 动画导出' video node; 逐帧拉片 is a canvas template made of group nodes (分镜组01/02/03, 动态｜运镜动作参考, 音乐｜BGM参考片段) containing shot image nodes (S07…S12 with camera/angle titles) and motion video nodes (M01…M03, 1920×1080); 智能剪辑 is a v-node with presets 讲解视频/批量广告/口播视频/素材混剪 and config 16:9·720P·30s.
Clicking 打开导演台 produced no observable overlay/URL in the bridge session (twice). Whether it opens a WebGL editor, a new tab, or requires membership is unknown.

Video node parameter disclosure has three tiers: (1) always visible chips 参考 / 标记 / 特效 / 角色库 / 运镜, reference thumbnails, prompt (描述你想要生成的画面内容，@引用素材), model '2.0', mode '全能参考', compact config string '16:9 · 720P · 5s · 1个'; (2) config popover on click (比例/清晰度/时长 4–15s/生成音频/数量 1·2·4); (3) 高级设置 group: 联网搜索, 自动校验素材, 智能引用 AutoLink.
Generation history is a canvas-side panel (not a separate page): scope radio 本画布 / 全部画布, type counters 图片/视频/音频, 按成员筛选, 所有评级 (per-result rating exists as a filter), 时间倒序, 批量操作.

Reusable identities: 角色库 offers platform-preset archetype characters (甜妹/清新少女, 霸总/精英大佬, 古风男主 …) each shipped as 全身图 + 面部特写 + 表情九宫格 + 人物呈现板 and applied via 应用至画布; the same 角色库 is reachable as a chip inside the video node. 素材库 and 工具箱 (团队工具箱 / 我的工具箱) are team-scoped libraries.

Agent is a right-docked drawer bound to the canvas; composer supports @ 引用工作流/节点/资源, model chips (添加模型), Skill chips, 生成模式 menu, attachments (image/video/audio/pdf/txt/md/doc). Adding a node from the empty state auto-inserted a node chip ('视频 · 点击定位到画布节点') into the composer.
Agent 设置 → 协作模式 has '自动生成图片/视频: 开启后，Agent 可直接消耗积分，提交图片/视频生成，无需逐次确认' and '积分预算管理' with 提醒阈值 (default 1000) — i.e. an explicit approval-vs-autonomy switch and per-project credit budget.
Sharing has two distinct verbs: 在LibTV上发布 ('发布你的作品和创作过程') and 分享链接 ('拥有此链接的人可以查看并复制你的画布'). Community cards expose 查看创作过程 which opens the creator's canvas read-only with 复制项目.

故事板 mode is a second view of the same canvas: content grouped by node type (文本/图片/视频 columns) with drag-and-drop, plus generated storyboard text nodes rendered as h3 sections (e.g. '📋 15秒详细分镜表 (Storyboard)') in the read-only viewer.

Selection: clicking a node produced no DOM change other than sync status; node toolbars (chips, prompt, config) are always rendered on the node, so LibTV does not use a selection-driven inspector — the node itself is the inspector. Right-click yields a clipboard/layout context menu.

Credits (积分) are shared with liblib.art (0 in both headers); membership upsell (开通会员 限时 42 折) is persistent chrome in the canvas top bar. Some models are labelled VIP (Seedance 2.0 VIP, Seedance 2.0 Fast VIP).
快捷键 and 教程 dock buttons produced no in-page overlay in the bridge; likely external links or a blocked new tab.
脚本 and 素材库 entries in 添加节点 are submenus (›); their contents were not captured.
